parts.note: a cape is a sleeveless cloak worn outside

explanation.surface: Someone choosing a coat that suits the springtime weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' looks like the season but is a verb-noun for a leap; a caper is a playful jump.
explanation.definitionFit: A caper is a frisky leap or skip, which is a spring.

clue.text: Little creature of nicest possible disposition

indicators.note: a possible disposition of the letters is one of their arrangements, so the word nicest is rearranged

explanation.surface: A small animal with the sweetest temperament imaginable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposition' pretends to mean temperament, but here means arrangement: the letters of NICEST are laid out afresh.
explanation.definitionFit: A bug or beetle is a tiny living thing, a little creature.

indicators.note: the head of the word skin is its leading letter

parts.note: to be trapped is to be caught

explanation.surface: A shaven-headed thug is arrested and thrashed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skinhead' reads as a thug but splits into 'skin' plus 'head', the first letter S, followed by TRAPPED.
explanation.definitionFit: To be strapped is to be thrashed with a leather belt, so beaten.

clue.text: Supervisor in favour of call up

parts.note: to be for something is to be in favour of it

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to call someone something is to name them

explanation.surface: A boss who supports summoning people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns NAME into EMAN, the down entry being read upward.
explanation.definitionFit: A foreman is the worker in charge of a gang or shop floor, a supervisor.

definitions.meaning: the 's stands for 'is': a female first name
calm acceptance of what cannot be changed

explanation.walkthrough: It reads like a woman quitting her job, but 'resignation' is the patient acceptance of fate.
explanation.definitionFit: Patience is a girl's name, and also uncomplaining endurance, which is resignation in its sense of acceptance.

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
reaching a place is getting to it

explanation.surface: A clergyman arriving at the start of something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opening' looks like a noun but works as a verb form: breaching a wall is opening it up.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaching a defence means making a gap in it, so opening it.

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse
a nation is a country

explanation.surface: Someone swearing at their motherland.
explanation.definitionFit: Damnation is used as an oath, a curse.

indicators.note: touring suggests travelling round, so the letters of Paris are moved about

explanation.surface: Romantic duos sightseeing in the French capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A pair is two people together, so couples are pairs.

indicators.note: about means the first word goes round the second

parts.note: to own something is to have it: he has
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: An artist from Holland possesses roughly fifty works.
explanation.walkthrough: Frans Hals painted The Laughing Cavalier.
explanation.definitionFit: Frans Hals was a seventeenth-century portraitist from Haarlem in the Netherlands.

clue.text: Some who are aggressive, get a telling off and become passive

indicators.note: some means only part of the following words is taken

explanation.surface: Belligerent people, after being scolded, calm down and go quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'aggressiVE GET A TElling'.
explanation.definitionFit: To vegetate is to lead a dull inactive life, becoming inert and passive.

clue.text: Beastly clever individual in a love situation

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held: 'Beastly clever individual in a love situation (6)' gives ANIMAL, but no parse of 'clever individual in a love situation' builds the letters; likely an OCR garble.
annotationWithheld.clue: Beastly clever individual in a love situation

clue.text: Favoured creatures set back one pace

indicators.note: set back means the word is put the wrong way round

parts.note: pets are favoured animals kept at home

explanation.surface: Beloved animals retreat by a stride.
explanation.definitionFit: A step is a single stride, one pace.

parts.note: ABs are able seamen, ordinary sailors
taken as written

explanation.surface: Sailors belonging to a trade union.
explanation.walkthrough: 'union' only joins the pieces: the sailors are united with IN THE.
explanation.definitionFit: Absinthe is a strong green aniseed-flavoured spirit, a drink.

clue.text: Penny and Rose appealing for wage

parts.note: taken as written
cute means attractive, appealing

explanation.surface: Two women making a plea for a pay rise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wage' looks like pay, but it is the verb, as in waging a war or campaign.
explanation.definitionFit: To prosecute a war is to carry it on, which is to wage it.

clue.text: Lead producers being quiet about yield

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held: 'Lead producers being quiet about yield (7)' gives PRECEDE as P + RE + CEDE with 'Lead' the definition, but 'producers being' has no job; likely an OCR garble.
annotationWithheld.clue: Lead producers being quiet about yield

indicators.note: organised means the letters are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A prison cell laid out with great cunning.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something cleverly means doing it with skill and invention, ingeniously.

clue.text: A girl about ten, one feels

indicators.note: about means the girl's name goes round the number

parts.note: Anna is a girl's name
taken as written

explanation.surface: A girl aged roughly ten, someone with feelings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one feels' sounds like a person with emotions, but it is an insect's feeler; 'about' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: An insect's antenna is a sensory organ it uses to touch, so a thing that feels.

parts.note: a score is twenty, and the number wanted is the one that twenty exceeds by just one

explanation.walkthrough: It reads like a plea to add a goal, but 'score' is twenty.
explanation.definitionFit: Twenty is one more than the number sought, so the number is one short of a score.

parts.note: a large wave crashing on a beach, and also one who smashes things

explanation.walkthrough: A spate of vandalism suggests a crime wave, but the wave is one that crashes on the shore, and a smasher is also a vandal.
explanation.definitionFit: A breaker is a heavy wave that crashes into foam, and someone who breaks things.

clue.text: He states quite positively a roster's to be changed

indicators.note: to be changed means the letters are rearranged into another word

parts.note: the 's here supplies a letter, so roster's gives its letters with the final S

explanation.surface: A confident man announces that the duty list will be revised.
explanation.walkthrough: A stays put at the front; 'to be changed' rearranges ROSTERS, the 's counting as a letter, into SSERTOR.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who asserts declares things firmly, stating them with confidence.

parts.note: a tin is a can
the T after the apostrophe stays as written

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry of someone unable to find a shady spot.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'Can't' as 'Can' (TIN) and 't'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tint is a variation of a colour, a shade.

explanation.walkthrough: 'as ordered' reads like a drink order being served, but 'ordered' means tidy.
explanation.definitionFit: Whisky served straight has no water added, and a tidy room is orderly; both words share the one adjective.

clue.text: Fool put in for entire property

indicators.note: in means the second word is placed inside the first

parts.note: an ass is a fool
to set something is to put it

explanation.surface: An idiot made a bid for a whole estate.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's assets are everything they own, their entire property.

definitions.meaning: the 's stands for 'is': a sour yellow citrus fruit
a dud, something failing or ugly

explanation.walkthrough: A lemon is both the citrus fruit and slang for a dud or something unappealing.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow citrus is a fruit, and slang calls a failure or ugly object a dud of that name.

clue.text: Cover up what a lot of people enjoy watching

definitions.text: what a lot of people enjoy watching

explanation.walkthrough: One word for hiding something and for the TV or cinema surface people watch.
explanation.definitionFit: To screen something is to conceal or shelter it, and the cinema or TV display people watch is also the screen.

clue.text: Entertainers taking a rest sit sprawled

indicators.note: sprawled suggests limbs flung out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Performers taking a break and lounging about.
explanation.definitionFit: Artistes are professional performers such as singers or dancers, entertainers.

parts.note: ST abbreviates saint, a good man
all means wholly, totally

explanation.surface: A virtuous man is completely steady.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stable' looks like an adjective but is the noun for a horse's quarters.
explanation.definitionFit: A stall is a compartment for one animal in a stable.

clue.text: Abandonment due to no one returning

parts.note: your deserts are what is due to you, as in just deserts

indicators.note: returning means these words are turned round

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A soldier walks out because nobody comes back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns NO plus I into ION.
explanation.definitionFit: Desertion is the leaving of a post or a person, abandonment.
